title: LockerPublicKey
description: locker.public-key@1: one P-256 public key as a JWK. The same shape is used for the ECDH key that receives content keys and for the ECDSA key that signs the fingerprint; what a key does is decided by where it is used, never by the key itself.

x.description: The public x coordinate, base64url, as WebCrypto exports it.

y.description: The public y coordinate, base64url, as WebCrypto exports it.
